title.en: Strong trust in head vet Grant

text.en: Clients place significant trust in head vet Grant and the reception team, expressing appreciation for their gentle manners and consistent attentiveness. While one review reported dissatisfaction with a nurse consultation, the vast majority of pet owners highlight compassionate, reliable veterinary service.

Pet owners consistently note that dogs and cats feel comfortable during visits, including nervous Bengal cats and anxious dogs. Reviewers appreciate the continuity of seeing the same veterinarian on repeated appointments, which reduces stress and creates a calm clinical atmosphere.

Recent feedback confirms successful medical outcomes, including routine dental interventions, health checks, and minor surgical operations. Clients value the thorough clinical evaluations and ongoing health oversight provided to pets from early puppyhood through senior years.

q.en: Can clients consistently see the same vet at Hampstead Village?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently note that seeing the same veterinary practitioner on return visits provides reassuring continuity for pets.

q.en: Does Medivet Hampstead Village issue Animal Health Certificates for travel?

a.en: Yes, the practice issues official EU travel documentation and certificates, with clients advising verifying requirements in advance.

q.en: Are surgical operations and dental treatments performed on site?

a.en: The practice carries out routine soft tissue surgery, dental evaluations, and preventative procedures on premises.

q.en: How quickly can regular appointments be scheduled?

a.en: Clients report obtaining consultation slots promptly and conveniently, with helpful booking support from reception.
